### Our Help Is in the Name of the Lord
Author: Robert VanDoodewaard
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-help-is-in-the-name-of-the-lord
Passage: Psalm 124:1-8
Points:
- Throughout Scripture and history, God's people have frequently been a small, vulnerable minority.
- The psalm depicts hostile opponents through vivid metaphors of devouring monsters and raging flash floods.
- Believers sing this psalm to bolster one another's confidence in the Lord's superior saving strength.
- God's timely deliverance is compared to a bird unexpectedly set free when a fowler's snare breaks.
- This rescue foreshadows the resurrection, guaranteeing that neither destruction nor the grave can hold believers.
- Small numbers and overwhelming odds simply become opportunities for the Creator of heaven and earth to reveal His deliverance.
